svg.text: 1999 m long, 105 m of height, 8 hairpins, sampled every 2.00 m.
Plan. Colour = grade: green under 5 %, yellow to 8 %, orange to 10 %, red above. Red rings: a limit is broken there. Numbers: metres along the road.
Side view of the hillside, looking along the runs (true to scale: 1 m up = 1 m across): a run seen end-on is short, a hairpin is the slope between.
crest (-) and dip (+): load at the reference speed (g)
Cross-sections (looking down the road, true to scale; black = road, grey = shoulder with the rails, green = land where it is known, blue dots = the height the car is given today)
